{{Top}}
[[File:ASN121CourierDroid-NEGTD.png|thumb|250px|An [[ASN courier droid/Legends|ASN courier droid]]]]
{{Quote|I have a message for Princess Leia Organa.|Message droid|<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
A '''courier droid''', '''delivery droid''', '''message droid''', or '''messenger droid''' was a droid designed to deliver information or packages to a designated recipient. Courier droids that worked for [[NewsNet]]s were often referred to as '''newsdroids'''.<ref name="KRR">{{JournalCite|6|Kella Rand, Reporting...}}</ref> If the designated recipient was not available, certain of these droids were authorized to deliver the message to an authorized representative, provided that representative could provide the password.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire" />
